visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation features a stylized, cream-colored cartoon snake with large, shimmering eyes and a friendly smile. The snake's body is decorated with blue and red cloud-like patterns. It wears a traditional red Chinese cap with a gold 'Fu' character in the center and large gold coins hanging from its sides. The setting is a festive nighttime urban scene filled with glowing red lanterns and a blurred silhouette of a tall tower like Taipei 101 in the distance. (2) The snake performs a rhythmic bobbing and twisting motion, swaying its head from side to side in synchronization with a beat. Its eyes blink expressively, and it occasionally winks at the camera. Tiny fireworks and light particles burst in the background, creating a dynamic and celebratory atmosphere. (3) Vibrant orange and white fireworks continue to explode in the sky. Text overlays appear at the top of the frame reading '蛇年如意' and 'Happy New Year 2025'. The snake maintains its cheerful dance-like movement against the warm, bokeh-filled background of lanterns until the sequence loops.
